description: MainActivity.kt defines the main entry point for an Android app, handling navigation, authentication status display, and role-based access control. It manages UI components such as navigation buttons and fragments for different screens including login and overview.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling app navigation, authentication, and role-based access control.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets up navigation, and determines initial screen based on sign-in status.

methods.name: bindNavViews
methods.description: Binds UI navigation buttons to their respective views.

methods.name: wireNavigation
methods.description: Sets click listeners for navigation buttons and authentication button.

methods.name: ensureAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if user is signed in and has access to a section before executing an action.

methods.name: applyRoleBasedNavigationVisibility
methods.description: Updates visibility of navigation buttons based on user roles.

methods.name: setSelectedNav
methods.description: Highlights the currently selected navigation button.

methods.name: navigateToLogin
methods.description: Navigates to the login fragment and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: navigateToList
methods.description: Navigates to a list fragment for a specific app section based on the kind.

methods.name: updateAuthUi
methods.description: Updates authentication button text and user info display based on sign-in state.

methods.name: onSignedIn
methods.description: Callback invoked after user signs in, updating UI and navigating to overview.
